OPEC+ Increases Output Amid Recovering Oil Shipments and Market Gains

OPEC+ has approved an increase in oil production for August, aiming to boost global crude availability and ease price pressures. This decision coincides with reports of recovering oil shipments from the Strait of Hormuz and a rise in Indian stock markets, particularly in bank stocks. Indian refiners have also secured significant crude oil purchases to bolster national reserves.
